title: A Quantitative Approach to Asch Conformity in Frontier Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36668v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Asch conformity experiment has recently gained considerable attention as a way of measuring conformity in large language models (LLMs). While previous studies have focused on demonstrating conformity in LLMs, our work adds a further quantitative layer to this approach. Instead of sampling a frontier LLM on a suite of questions, our approach samples a single question repeatedly, leveraging the probabilistic nature of LLMs to produce a distribution of answers. In doing so, we can compare the distributions of answers before and after the model is presented with the manufactured consensus. Our experiments confirm that frontier LLMs do conform, reinforcing prior literature, and, through our distribution-to-distribution comparisons, provide additional quantitative data on the conditions that lead to conformity and the degree to which it occurs.

translated_title: 前沿大语言模型中阿希从众效应的定量研究方法
translated_abstract: 阿希从众实验最近作为衡量大语言模型（LLM）从众性的一种方法受到了广泛关注。虽然以往的研究主要集中于证明LLM中存在从众现象，但我们的工作为这一方法增加了更进一步的定量层面。我们的方法不是在一组问题上对前沿LLM进行采样，而是对单个问题进行重复采样，利用LLM的概率特性产生答案的分布。通过这种方式，我们可以比较模型在被展示人为制造的共识之前和之后的答案分布。我们的实验证实了前沿LLM确实存在从众行为，这强化了以往文献的结论，并且通过我们的分布间比较，提供了关于导致从众的条件以及从众发生程度的额外定量数据。
tldr: 该论文提出一种定量方法，通过对单个问题重复采样获得答案分布，并比较模型接触人为制造共识前后的分布差异，证实前沿大语言模型存在从众效应，并量化了从众发生的条件与程度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a quantitative approach that repeatedly samples a single question to compare answer distributions before and after exposure to manufactured consensus, confirming that frontier LLMs exhibit conformity and quantifying the conditions and degree of such conformity.
